export async function inOrder(items, step, {reason}) {
 for (const item of items) await step(item);
}
export const inOrderSteps = async (steps, {reason}) => {
 for (const step of steps)
  await step();
};
async function unrelated(items, step) {
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const item of items) await step(item);
}
